title: AI Business Application Consultation
tagline: Where AI actually pays in your business — and what to ignore.
approachNote: We work on your business, not slides.
outcomes: Two or three ranked use cases, each with a cost range and the assumption behind it.
A 30-day test for the first one — named owner, success threshold, kill criterion.
A short list of what to ignore, so you stop paying attention to the wrong pitches.

outline.item: Where time, money, and repeat work actually go.
A working session on your numbers — rank two or three by payoff.
Pick one; give it an owner, a threshold, and a stop rule.

formats.label: 1-on-1 consultation
formats.detail: 2 hrs · you + a key person or two

faq.q: Is this a sales pitch for tools or software?
faq.a: No. I have nothing to sell you afterwards — no platform, no subscription, no affiliate links. We work on your operation and you leave with a plan, not a shopping list.

faq.q: What should I bring, and who should join?
faq.a: Bring how your business actually runs — where time and money go — and, ideally, one key person who knows the day-to-day. Rough numbers are fine; you don't need a finance report.

faq.q: Will you tell me exactly what to build?
faq.a: I help you rank where AI is likely to pay and design a 30-day test with a named owner. What to fund is your call — the point is to make it an informed one, not a guess.
